project_type: React + Vite SPA with Python FastAPI backend
test_framework: vitest (but tests NOT required for this task)
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. npm run typecheck (zero errors), 2. npm run lint (zero errors, warnings OK), 3. npm run build (produces dist/)
setup_instructions: npm install already done. Need: npm install jspdf jszip
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET, can install packages. No Docker needed for frontend-only build.
contribution_requirements: No tests required. Lint must have ZERO errors (warnings OK). TypeScript strict mode not enabled but noEmit must pass.
key_patterns: Zustand stores in store/, features organized in features/ directory, components in components/. IndexedDB via services/imageStorage.ts (currently version 2 with 'images' and 'fonts' stores). Backend uses Pydantic schemas with CamelModel base. SettingsPanel has tab-based UI. BubbleOverlay handles individual bubble rendering.
directory_structure: Root: App.tsx (main app), types.ts (shared types). store/ (zustand stores). features/ (viewer, settings, translator). components/ (MangaViewer, BubbleOverlay, etc). services/ (imageStorage). backend/app/ (FastAPI with providers/, routers/, schemas/).
